messages:
Alex (sales): heads-up: NovaCore POC cutover in ~30m. Private/VPC + SAML. They saw 429s and an intermittent SAML error during yesterday's smoke. need a quick swarm to avoid demo slip.
Tara (CS): demo locked for tomorrow 09:00 PT. customer asked for IP allowlist and export sample. also asked about audit-log retention.
Dev (eng): can you paste a short repro of the 429? are these per-connection spikes or sustained?
Alex (sales): sanitized repro from their gateway:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer tok_xxx
Body:{"input":"hi"}
Response: 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":0.8}
```
They said bursts ~150rps.
Noah (infra): are they on our control plane routing or full on-prem?
Alex (sales): hybrid: they host GPUs, we control routing. concurrency=6 per worker.
Dev (eng): likely causes: fronting per-org burst limiter + gateway retry amplification. quick mitigation: temp rate override and route to a canary pool. Noah can you create an override?
Noah (infra): creating override now: novacore-temp-burst-2024. provisioning canary novacore-canary-02. adding CIDR 198.51.100.16/28 to allowlist.
deploy-bot: policy novacore-temp-burst-2024 created by Noah at 2024-08-24T18:12:03Z :white_check_mark:
Dev (eng): asked customer to pause aggressive retries and send one full request/response with headers (SAML + x-org-id).
Alex (sales): they sent SAML error: "InvalidAudience". forwarding to Iris.
Iris (security): InvalidAudience usually means SP entity ID mismatch. also check clock skew and cert thumbprints. we don't log raw assertions (only ID + status). I'll send a short checklist to their IdP admin.
Tara (CS): pricing note: they requested a demo SLA discount if we hit tomorrow. legal wants a one-page amendment for Private.
Dev (eng): applied soft smoothing throttle (policy novacore-smooth-2024) and enabled prefix caching for repeated prompts. running a short load test.
(3m later)
Dev (eng): load test looks much better. 429s dropped to near zero on canary. p95 latency stable.
Alex (sales): customer confirmed single-user flows pass. synthetic stress still shows a few failures; they've agreed to add jitter on retries.
Iris (security): drafting SSQ answers: audit-log export to S3 endpoint in their VPC, retention=365d, KMS key mapping documented. will paste in thread.
Noah (infra): leaving canary up for 24h and adding alert: if 429 rate > 1% over 5m, page infra.
Tara (CS): I'll assemble a 1-page cutover/rollback checklist and share.
Alex (sales): follow-ups assigned: Dev -> finalize policy & repo changes; Noah -> monitor canary; Iris -> SSQ + SAML guidance; Tara -> runbook & customer comms; Alex -> pricing/MSA. thanks team. :thumbsup:
